article.headline: Astrum Ampang A-15-05 Turnkey Studio — Rental-Ready Studio Condominium in Ampang
article.description: A 280 sqft studio at Astrum Ampang, unit A-15-05, completed into a move-in-ready rental on an RM 11,500 all-inclusive budget. Features wainscoted feature walls with professional painting, full-length double-track main and sheer curtains, a kitchen extension with melamine cabinetry and quartz stone countertop, Faber electric hood and ceramic cooker, Toshiba two-door refrigerator, Hisense washer dryer combo, 50-inch Google TV, and bathroom fittings, targeting RM 1,500/month rental.
